mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books) book_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_copies WHERE status!='RETIRED') total_copies, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_copies WHERE status='AVAILABLE') available_copies, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE status='ACTIVE') active_loans, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND due_date < #{today}) overdue_loans, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE status='READY') ready_reservations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role='READER' AND status='ACTIVE') reader_count

SELECT day date,SUM(borrowed_count) borrowed_count,SUM(returned_count) returned_count FROM ( SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(borrowed_at,'+00:00','+08:00')) day,COUNT(*) borrowed_count,0 returned_count FROM loans WHERE borrowed_at >= #{from} GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(borrowed_at,'+00:00','+08:00')) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(returned_at,'+00:00','+08:00')) day,0 borrowed_count,COUNT(*) returned_count FROM loans WHERE returned_at >= #{from} GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(returned_at,'+00:00','+08:00')) ) t GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT b.id book_id,b.title,COUNT(l.id) borrow_count FROM loans l JOIN books b ON b.id=l.book_id WHERE l.borrowed_at >= #{from} GROUP BY b.id,b.title ORDER BY borrow_count DESC,b.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
